text:
rachel: thinking about org billing layout — persistent left rail (filters + token breakdown) vs stacked cards. which for discoverability?
tom: left rail desktop, keeps timeline centered.
vikas: stacked cards for responsive behavior. easier on small windows.
elaine: accessibility: if left rail, add skip link and `role="region" aria-label="Billing controls"`.
vikas: also, token colors fail contrast at small sizes; add patterns or 1-2px borders and explicit labels.
rachel: export CTA: many expect PDF. propose primary "Download invoice" opens menu: PDF / CSV / Line items.
tom: track which export is chosen so we can surface the most-used default.
elaine: invoice modal should trap focus and have heading "Invoice	6-2026	6 Redwood Inference" and a clear close button.
ux-bot: Figma frames uploaded: https://figma.com/file/newlayout123 — includes rail + stacked + mobile accordion plus ARIA notes.
rachel: action items: tom — prototype rail + keyboard/focus behavior; vikas — high-contrast legend + colorblind patterns; elaine — modal ARIA copy and focus trap. quick 15m sync after prototypes?
tom: on it, will push prototype by EOD.
